name: Lucy & Yak

notes: Title: 'Lucy and Yak Independent UK Design Street Wear Clothing Brand – Lucy & Yak US'. Meta: 'Colorful, comfy clothing designed in Britain, made from organic and recycled fabrics. Independent and employee owned, so we put people before profit.'
Size & Fit page: 'sizes UK 4-32 / US 0-28 (with long versions available) as well as Petite and Tall ranges'.
US store banner: 'FREE DELIVERY ON ALL ORDERS OVER $150'. Refund policy: return within 30 days of receiving the order.
Supplier partners page lists named factories with addresses, audits and partnership length (e.g. Chelsea Mills, Haryana, India; 826 employees; Sedex SMETA).
Imperfect Idealist: 'best-known for its slouchy dungarees/overalls'; Overalls is the first item in the store's clothing nav.
